editorial:
Imagine being a top-tier detective who is way too excited about catching bad guys. That is exactly who you meet in this wild ride. You get to follow Tsukasa, a cop who does not care about rules or warrants as long as he gets the criminal. He is basically a human wrecking ball. The vibe is totally chaotic and funny because his passion gets him into huge trouble. Instead of getting a promotion for stopping a phone scam, he gets demoted to the police musical band. Watching a hardcore detective try to fit in with a group of musicians is a hilarious setup that keeps you laughing from the start.

What really makes this work is how the movie switches between goofy comedy and actual action. The acting is great, and the pacing never slows down, making it a quick and easy watch. While some of the plot points are a bit silly, the energy is contagious. If you want something light and loud, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The story wraps up when Tsukasa uses his new position in the band to secretly keep investigating the crime ring. He manages to track down the bosses of the voice phishing scam while still pretending to be a musician. In a big final showdown, he uses his combat skills to take them all down. He proves that his instincts were right all along, finally getting the respect he wanted while keeping his unique, rule-breaking spirit.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy cop comedies and high energy action.
